CustomField.description: Maximum number of retry attempts when Database.getCursor() times out during coordinator execution. Effective maximum is 5: Salesforce allows a transaction finalizer to re-enqueue a failed Queueable at most 5 consecutive times, so higher values are clamped to 5 by the framework and a warning is logged.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How many times the coordinator retries when the cursor query times out. Default is 3. Do not set above 5: Salesforce lets a finalizer re-enqueue a failed job at most 5 consecutive times, so higher values are clamped to 5 and a warning is logged. If a query keeps timing out, make it more selective (indexed fields, narrower filters) rather than raising this.
CustomField.label: Coordinator Max Retries
